blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran actor John Arcilla has asked the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to help examine the remains of his departed fur babies following the recently reported pet crematorium scam. Arcilla arrived at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City on Wednesday, carrying a suitcase containing the urns of his two departed dogs, Dindin and Yapyap, which he said were cremated at a pet crematorium in Cavite.
